_comment: Guided tour for the FRET check tool. Targets are the app's panels; steps with an await wait for the user.

steps.title: What this checks
steps.text: FRET check walks a single-molecule FRET measurement in one pass: the experiment is detected, the bursts are found, and a QC verdict says what is wrong in plain words. Everything runs locally.

steps.title: Start from an example
steps.text: The example button loads a simulated measurement with a known answer, so every panel that follows can be judged against what should be there.

steps.title: Channels and windows
steps.text: Channels shows the micro-time histogram of every detector with the excitation windows marked. A wrong window guess breaks everything downstream — fix it here and press Apply.

steps.title: The time trace
steps.text: Time trace shows the count rate of each stream in 1 ms bins with the bursts shaded. Judge the burst search here: a good run shows clean bursts over a flat background.

steps.title: E/S and the burst table
steps.text: E/S is the joint burst histogram. ndX holds the full burst table — lifetimes, anisotropies, TGX−TRR, 2CDE, QC flags — choose any two columns and gate populations through the other dimensions.

steps.title: The verdict
steps.text: The checks table flags occupancy, stoichiometry, background and burst density; Issues names the cause and the fix for every red. Report writes the A4 PDF.

await.hint: Read the QC verdict, then press Report for the PDF.
